    """Return a new list of ``(name, value)`` header tuples with header names lower‑cased.

    ``httpx`` is case‑insensitive for header names, but many downstream components (and
    some test suites) expect the names to be normalised to lower case.  This helper
    therefore normalises the ``name`` part of each tuple while leaving the ``value``
    untouched.
    """

    # ``headers`` may be any iterable of ``(name, value)`` where ``name`` and ``value``
    # are ``bytes``.  We decode the name, lower‑case it, then re‑encode to ``bytes``.
    # If the name is already lower‑case this is a no‑op.
    normalised: list[tuple[bytes, bytes]] = []
    for name, value in headers:
        # Decode using latin‑1 which round‑trips any byte value.
        lower_name = name.decode("latin-1").lower().encode("latin-1")
        normalised.append((lower_name, value))
    return normalised"
